_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Broadcom: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor, or CMOS, based devices and analog III-V based products', 'We have four reportable segments: wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2016 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: the company's own FY2016 10-K says 'In addition, the shift to cloud-based IT solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, may adversely affect both our wired infrastructure and enterprise storage segments.' At the same time it sells into data centers itself: 'In the data center market, our high capacity, low latency, switching silicon supports advanced protocols around virtualization and multi-pathing'. The stock trades at 50.6x FY17E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of its enterprise storage and networking specifically.

classification.quality_note: Broadcom: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor, or CMOS, based devices and analog III-V based products', 'We have four reportable segments: wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2016 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1023.58x; +261% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.37; conservative 2yr -62%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY08-FY15 ex-FY09 ex-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.5%/yr (Q3 FY17 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.7-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY14 ex-FY16 median

BULL.desc: EPS +52.3%/yr (FY08-FY15 ex-FY09 ex-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY15 ex-FY09 ex-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2017-07-14) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1023.58x (77.7% downside to Bear $55.81 / +0.1% upside to Bull $250.48) | Adj composite 3.15 vs market 2.78: gap +0.37 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +261% above the EPP floor $69.30 (14x FY17E $4.95) | Conservative 2-yr case: -61.8% total (-30.9%/yr) | At 50.6x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $331.01 sits above the BULL case; net revenue +18.3% YoY in Q2 FY17, forward revenues +15.2-19.2% (Q3 FY17 revenue guide (Q2 FY17 release)); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
